How to order

No sign-up and no cart. You just chat with us.

  1. Pick your pieceChoose a bag, sweater or accessory from the collection.
  2. Send the messageTap Order on WhatsApp. The product name and price are already written for you.
  3. Confirm on chatWe confirm colour, payment and delivery with you, then start making your piece.
